LanguageData.LP_PsionicSuppressant.label: psionic suppressant
LanguageData.LP_PsionicSuppressant.description: A pill that suppresses psionic parasites. Taken while tadpole ceremorphosis progress is under 50%, it freezes the transformation, making the host a "half-illithid" who keeps their self: can read minds and devour brains, learning one psionic power per brain devoured (up to 3).\n\nThe effect lasts 3 days; 3 days after stopping the pills the transformation resumes. Each brain devoured has a 25% chance to break the suppression.
